changelog:
Aegis4All 1.0.0 — initial release for OpenClaw security hardening.

- Adds "safe check"/"security check" trigger for comprehensive, read-only config audits with scored reports and prioritized recommendations.
- Enables "inject rules" trigger to append 7 security behavior rules into workspace files, using a confirmation protocol.
- Provides "security guide"/"show guide" triggers for high-risk operation guides, including step-by-step instructions and refusal protocol for unsafe actions.
- Implements multilayer audit strategies (privilege, port binding, credential checks, key scanning, skill vetting, etc.) following Zheng Tan & Lin 2026.
- No auto-remediation; actions requiring user intervention are clearly marked as INFO with guide references and agent display support.
- Integrates self-exclusion and update/removal options for injected rules, ensuring safe incremental adoption.
summary: Secure your OpenClaw with one click. Audit, harden, and fix — no expertise needed. Plain-language reports surface hidden risks. Built-in rules block misuse automatically. Clear guides tell non-technical users exactly what to do.
